title: 第一卷 第9章 你是水家族长你女儿的婚事你做不了主第一卷 第10章 冰儿你别为难了为父明白你的心意
slug: 斗罗v开局上交系统全宗为我抢亲
lines: 话音落下，火舞脸上的血色也瞬间褪得干干净净，脑子里嗡嗡作响。
这废物居然是冲着水冰儿来的？
不过，就算是水冰儿，又如何？
刚说她配不上，水冰儿就配得上了？
“水冰儿？”
火舞咬着牙，原本绝美的脸蛋有些扭曲，
“宁天！
你是不是瞎了眼？”
“我火舞哪点比不上水冰儿那个冰块脸！”
“论天赋，我是变异武魂火影，论身材，我哪点不比她强？”
“你一个连魂师都不是的废物，凭什么在这里对我挑三拣四！”
不得不说，有些女人就是这样。
前一秒在意的是千万不要选自己！
后一秒就变成了，你凭什么选水冰儿不选自己！
这些话说完，大殿内又是安静得可怕。
火家族长吓得头皮发麻，恨不得冲上去捂住这丫头的嘴。
疯了！
真是疯了！
这可是七宝琉璃宗的少主，你就算心里再不爽，也不能当着人家亲爹和剑斗罗的面三番两次一口一个废物啊！
果不其然。
坐在主位上的宁风致，脸上那如沐春风的笑意一点点消失了。
他放下茶杯，没有说话，只是极其平淡地瞥了站在大殿侧面的赵长老一眼。
赵长老自然懂什么意思。
“放肆！”
他一步跨出，脚下七个魂环猛地亮起，魂圣级别的狂暴威压如同山呼海啸般席卷而出，直接锁定在火舞身上。
火舞此刻不过是个三十多级的魂尊，哪里承受得住这种级别的威压？
她闷哼一声，双腿一软，直接跪倒在地。
还没等她反应过来，赵长老已经犹如鬼魅般欺身而上。
一记极其响亮的耳光在大殿内炸开。
火舞整个人被抽得原地转了半圈，重重地摔在地上。
左半边脸瞬间红肿，五个清晰的指印浮现出来，嘴角甚至溢出了一丝鲜血。
“三番两次辱骂我七宝琉璃宗少主，真当老夫不敢杀你？”
赵长老甩了甩手腕，居高临下地俯视着地上的火舞，语气森寒。
这一巴掌，彻底把大殿里的人打蒙了。
“舞儿！”
火家族长目眦欲裂。
自己视若掌上明珠的女儿，什么时候受过这种委屈！
若是宁宗主打她两巴掌就算了，你一个外门长老，也当众扇巴掌？！
content_en:
As soon as he finished speaking, the color on Huo Wu's face faded completely, and his mind was buzzing.
This trash actually came for Shui Bing'er?
But, even if it’s Shui Bing’er, so what?
Just now she was said to be unworthy, but Shui Bing'er is worthy?
"Shui Bing'er?"
Huo Wu gritted his teeth, his originally beautiful face was a little distorted,
"Ning Tian!
Are you blind? "
"There is no way I, Huo Wu, can compare to Shui Bing'er's ice face!"
"In terms of talent, I am the mutated martial spirit Hokage. In terms of figure, in what way am I not better than her?"
"You are a loser who is not even a soul master. Why are you picking on me here!"
It has to be said that some women are like this.
The first thing I care about is not to choose yourself!
The next second it became, why did you choose Shui Bing'er instead of yourself!
After saying these words, the hall became eerily quiet again.
The leader of the Huo family was so frightened that he wanted to rush up and cover the girl's mouth.
Crazy!
It's crazy!
This is the young master of the Seven Treasures Glazed Sect. No matter how unhappy you are, you can't treat him like a piece of trash over and over again in front of his father and Sword Douluo!
Sure enough.
Ning Fengzhi, who was sitting in the main seat, had the spring-like smile on his face disappearing little by little.
He put down the teacup and said nothing, but glanced at Elder Zhao who was standing on the side of the hall very flatly.
Elder Zhao naturally understands what it means.
"Presumptuous!"
He took one step forward, and the seven soul rings under his feet suddenly lit up. The violent pressure of the Soul Saint level swept out like a roaring mountain and a tsunami, and locked directly on Huo Wu.
Huo Wu is just a soul master in his thirties at the moment. How can he withstand the pressure of this level?
She groaned, her legs softened, and she fell to her knees.
Before she could react, Elder Zhao was already approaching her like a ghost.
"Crack!"
An extremely loud slap exploded in the hall.
Huo Wu was whipped around half a circle and fell heavily to the ground.
The left half of his face instantly became red and swollen, five clear fingerprints emerged, and a trace of blood even spilled from the corner of his mouth.
"You have repeatedly insulted me, the young master of the Qibao Glazed Sect, do you really think I dare not kill you?"
Elder Zhao flicked his wrist and looked down at Huo Wu on the ground with a cold tone.
This slap completely stunned everyone in the hall.
"Wu'er!"
The head of the Fire Family's eyes were about to burst.
When has the daughter whom I regard as the apple of my eye ever been wronged like this?
If Sect Leader Ning just slapped her twice, why don't you, an outer elder, slap her in public? !
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 9 You are the head of the Shui family and you can’t decide on your daughter’s marriage Volume 1 Chapter 10 Bing’er, don’t be embarrassed. My father understands your feelings.
